# Rolling-origin stability at 72 h and 168 h (generated by `scripts/run_rolling_origin.py`)

Git commit `8dd491c3d9`. Only data up to 2023-12-31 was loaded (no validation or test targets). MAE in MW; XGBoost and LSTM are the mean over 3 seeds of the per-seed MAE (range in brackets). Frozen configurations of each horizon (including the number of trees/epochs found on the main validation split) are re-used in every fold, so this tests the stability of the procedure across periods, not a re-tuned model. Fold 3 is the main split (validation 2024-H1), taken from the existing logs.

## Horizon 72 h

| fold | train / eval samples | best naive | ridge | XGBoost S4 | LSTM L4 | XGBoost vs ridge | LSTM vs XGBoost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| fold 1 (train to 2022-12, eval 2023-H1) | 11,046 / 4,343 | 7,686 | 6,361 | 6,633 (6,530-6,723) | 6,689 (6,510-6,974) | +272 | +56 |
| fold 2 (train to 2023-06, eval 2023-H2) | 15,389 / 4,414 | 7,528 | 6,487 | 5,867 (5,818-5,947) | 6,221 (6,023-6,461) | -620 | +354 |

## Horizon 168 h

| fold | train / eval samples | best naive | ridge | XGBoost S4 | LSTM L4 | XGBoost vs ridge | LSTM vs XGBoost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| fold 1 (train to 2022-12, eval 2023-H1) | 10,945 / 4,343 | 9,416 | 9,104 | 9,089 (9,056-9,123) | 9,329 (9,256-9,439) | -15 | +240 |
| fold 2 (train to 2023-06, eval 2023-H2) | 15,288 / 4,414 | 8,424 | 8,103 | 8,077 (8,029-8,133) | 8,241 (8,161-8,342) | -26 | +164 |

Differences are in MW (negative = first model better). Only three folds of half a year each, with one set of frozen hyper-parameters; the table shows whether the ranking of the models is stable, not a significance test.
